title: Add Request ID & Trace Middleware
description: Introduce a lightweight middleware that generates a unique request ID for every incoming HTTP request, attaches it to the response headers, and logs the ID with request details. This improves observability, simplifies debugging, and enables correlation across logs and external monitoring tools.
testCases: Should assign a UUIDv4 request ID header (X-Request-Id) to every response
Should include the same request ID in the structured log entry for the request
Should propagate the request ID through subsequent middlewares and route handlers
acceptance: All tests pass, the X-Request-Id header is present and unique per request, and logs contain the matching ID without affecting existing functionality or performance thresholds.
reason: Observability is critical for production stability; a request trace middleware provides immediate value for debugging, performance monitoring, and integrates with log aggregation services without adding external dependencies.
